criteria.reason: The complete opening directly states validation-gated publication, the candidate-and-replace decision, and its cost and failure consequence before any history. The missing-endpoint example makes the next implementation and verification decision understandable.

evidence.quote: Publish a new configuration only after every required field validates; invalid input keeps the active configuration unchanged. Build a candidate then replace the active reference once validation succeeds. This costs one temporary candidate but avoids partial activation: a missing endpoint retains the old endpoint and credentials together. Next implement and verify that rejection example.
